text.p: Immudyne Inc said Tuesday its president, L. Melvin Cooper, is resigning effective August 13 to pursue other opportunities.
The company said Leonid Ber has been appointed chief operating officer and will assume certain duties of the president until a successor for Cooper is appointed.
It said Robert Nakamura, who is a director, will become board chairman, replacing James Wood.
Wood will continue as a director and will hold the honorary title of chairman emeritus, it said.
It further said that Andrew Calhoun, who joined the board about three months ago at the request of Cooper, is resigning for personal reasons.
John Joshua will replace Calhoun, it said.

Nakamura is the chairman emeritus and senior consultant with the Department of Pathology at Scripps Clinic and Research Foundation and is an expert and author in the fields of pathology and immunology.
